title: Yummy Smoky Portuguese Cheese Frittata
description: A cultured, dense, festive Portuguese dish featuring Colby-Jack cheese and binchotan charcoal for a low-carb twist.
instructions: Preheat oven to 175C and lightly grease a 20cm round baking dish with olive oil infused with crushed binchotan charcoal.
In a skillet over medium heat, cook diced bacon until crisp, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add diced onion and garlic, sauté until translucent.
Add diced green pepper and chopped spinach, cook until wilted, then remove from heat.
Whisk eggs in a bowl, season with smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Stir shredded colby jack cheese into the egg mixture until melted.
Fold in cooked bacon, sautéed vegetables, and a small drizzle of the infused olive oil.
Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish, spreading evenly.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the frittata is set and lightly golden on top.
Let rest for 5 minutes, slice into wedges, and serve warm.
